quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
method_note: Headline value = most negative median of ~1 km blocks (13x13 px, >= 50 % valid pixels, within-block std <= 2 cm) of the cumulative LOS map. Rate = linear extrapolation of 108 days (2026-06-27 to 2026-10-13, summer season) to one year: an ESTIMATE that likely overstates the annual net rate because part of summer subsidence recovers in winter. Vertical value assumes purely vertical motion (LOS / cos(incidence)). range_cm = spread of the headline value when the whole chain is re-referenced to up to two other stable windows >= 30 km away.
